criteria.reason: exempt by position: the trailing criterion is the build-green safety net, green before the work by design

amendments.reason: Criterio de rascunho, com marcador nao preenchido. Substituido pelo comportamento que a unidade entrega: o prefixo passa a dizer o que a unidade E.
amendments.superseded_statement: when <o novo comportamento é acionado>, then <o resultado observável esperado se mantém>
amendments.statement: when a work unit is opened, then its branch is named by the unit's kind as feature/, fix/ or hotfix/, never by the base it was cut from

amendments.reason: Criterio de rascunho, com marcador nao preenchido. Substituido pela consequencia critica da mudanca: base_for hoje recupera a base fazendo longest-match no nome, e e esse consumidor que quebra se o prefixo deixar de nomear a base.
amendments.superseded_statement: when <um caminho de erro ou de borda ocorre>, then <o sistema responde conforme especificado>
amendments.statement: when a branch name no longer carries the base, then the base is still resolved from the flow declared in mustard.json and never from the branch string

additions.reason: Unidades em voo seriam orfanadas: o alvo do pull request, a verificacao de ja-integrado e a recusa da segunda unidade resolvem a unidade pelo nome do branch.
additions.statement: when a branch carries the old base-prefixed shape, then it is still recognised as that unit's branch and still resolves to its base

additions.reason: E a unica diferenca real entre fix e hotfix: o destino. Sem criterio aqui, o prefixo hotfix seria cosmetico.
additions.statement: when the unit is a hotfix, then it is cut from an integration base that is not the default work base, and the operator chooses when more than one candidate exists
